0.name: TEXT_CTSDDD3ENTRANCE_00817_KHATUN_000_000
0.description: Welcome, welcome! I am at your complete disposal as you venture forth into Eureka Orthos. I was given the honor of this appointment directly by Archmagus Noah, and I don't intend to let her down!
0.translation_description: Benvenuto, benvenuto! Sono a tua completa disposizione mentre ti addentri in Eureka Orthos. L'arcimago Noah mi ha affidato direttamente l'onore di questo incarico e non intendo deluderla!

10.name: TEXT_CTSDDD3ENTRANCE_00817_ENTER_FIXED_Q
10.description: Are you sure you wish to enter with a fixed party?
10.translation_description: Confermi l'ingresso con un gruppo prefissato?

11.name: TEXT_CTSDDD3ENTRANCE_00817_ENTER_MATCHING_Q
11.description: Are you sure you wish to enter with a matched party?
11.translation_description: Confermi l'ingresso con un gruppo abbinato?

12.name: TEXT_CTSDDD3ENTRANCE_00817_KHATUN_000_010
12.description: You would brave Eureka Orthos alone!? Well, G'raha Tia and the archmagus have placed so much faith in you, and if they're not worried, I won't be─Allag's secrets are in your capable hands!
12.translation_description: Vuoi affrontare Eureka Orthos in solitaria!? G'raha Tia e l'arcimago hanno riposto tanta fiducia in te e, se loro non sono preoccupati, non lo sarò neanch'io: i segreti allagani sono in buone mani!

13.name: TEXT_CTSDDD3ENTRANCE_00817_ENTER_SOLO
13.description: Are you sure you wish to enter alone?

14.name: TEXT_CTSDDD3ENTRANCE_00817_ENTER_WHICH_Q
14.description: From which floor will you enter?

19.name: TEXT_CTSDDD3ENTRANCE_00817_MIDDLE_TOP_MENU_EXPLAIN
19.translation_description: Consulta le regole di Eureka Orthos

20.name: TEXT_CTSDDD3ENTRANCE_00817_MIDDLE_Q
20.description: Proceed to the next floor with your current party?
20.translation_description: Vuoi procedere al piano successivo con il gruppo attuale?
